as records get .records
as labels get .labels

# text_is: a str, a bool, an int and a null by their text
filter @records silt__text_is .status passed
filter @records silt__text_is .archived false
filter @records silt__text_is .tries 2
filter @records silt__text_is .owner null
find @records silt__text_is .name lint
any @records silt__text_is .status skipped
all @records silt__text_is .archived false

# text_is: a path that holds nothing or a list has the empty text
filter @records silt__text_is .status
filter @records silt__text_is .reads

# text_is: the member itself
filter @labels silt__text_is . type/fix
filter @labels silt__text_is .

# text_is_not
filter @records silt__text_is_not .status passed
filter @labels silt__text_is_not .
all @labels silt__text_is_not . area/
any @labels silt__text_is_not . area/

# text_starts_with
filter @labels silt__text_starts_with . area/
filter @labels silt__text_starts_with .
filter @records silt__text_starts_with .name te
any @records silt__text_starts_with .status x
find @labels silt__text_starts_with . type
